summary.business_type: Local service / B2B facilities management (service-area business), Saudi Arabia
top_findings: Service pages are thin: 39-68 words of main content each
No verifiable identity: no address, city, CR or VAT number, About page
No city named anywhere; ranking pages in this sector are city-scoped
Sitemap lists 3 URLs that serve the homepage and omits 2 real pages; unknown slugs return 200
Project images return 403; mobile menu button does nothing; logo is 1.47 MB
quick_wins: Fix the sitemap (remove 3 dead URLs, add contracting and workforce)
Compress the logo to SVG or ~10 KB WebP
Fix the mobile menu; add tel: link and sticky WhatsApp button
summary.limits: Only otlobny.net was reachable: no PageSpeed/CrUX field data, no Search Console, no Google Business Profile, backlinks or off-site checks. Performance figures are single-run lab measurements.
